findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: No Content-Security-Policy header. This weakens defenses against XSS and data-injection attacks.
findings.recommendation: Add a `Content-Security-Policy` header with an appropriate policy.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.detail: No X-Content-Type-Options header. Browsers may MIME-sniff responses, enabling certain attacks.
findings.recommendation: Add a `X-Content-Type-Options` header with an appropriate policy.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.detail: No X-Frame-Options header. Page may be vulnerable to clickjacking via iframe embedding.
findings.recommendation: Add a `X-Frame-Options` header with an appropriate policy.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: No Referrer-Policy header. Full URLs (possibly with sensitive query params) may leak via the Referer header.
findings.recommendation: Add a `Referrer-Policy` header with an appropriate policy.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.detail: No Permissions-Policy header. Browser features (camera, geolocation, etc.) are not explicitly restricted.
findings.recommendation: Add a `Permissions-Policy` header with an appropriate policy.

findings.title: Server banner exposed
findings.recommendation: Suppress or genericize the Server header.

findings.title: Port 80 (HTTP) open
findings.recommendation: Confirm this service should be internet-facing; firewall it off if not.

findings.title: Port 443 (HTTPS) open
findings.recommendation: Confirm this service should be internet-facing; firewall it off if not.
